name: dsh-pollyreach
description: pollyreach-dsh-plugin is a phone communication plugin built for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Powered by the Cordis plugin system, it gives DeepSeek AI agents a dedicated phone number and the ability to make outbound calls, receive incoming calls, retrieve call results, check balances, and customize AI answering behavior.
